postingQuotes:
What started as a 2-human screen printing shop in a garage in 2009, has quickly evolved into an all encompassing artist merch design/production/management/fulfillment company based in Eau Claire, WI. We work with any array of artists from those that play house shows to artists touring the globe, along with various other clients that share our values. We’re committed to doing business in a way that puts people and planet first, a mindset that rethinks the impact merch can have on our world.

For more info about what we’re all about, check out our website.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We ar

* Is cross-trained in multiple departments well enough to serve as a backup and/or intermittent support on tasks including but not limited to: Production, Unloading, Catching, Folding, Checking in goods, Podio (project management software), Fulfillment, ShipStation, Batching, Shipping label generation, Shipping & Receiving, Stock-ins/outs, Booking freight, Coordinating international shipping, Palletizing

* Must be able to stand for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours) and consistently lift 25–35lb boxes while supporting certain roles

**Human Resources, Staffing & Policy Development**

*

**Human Resources, Staffing & Policy Development**

* Ensures we have adequate staffing levels in each department. Works closely with leadership and managers to understand and balance workloads across multiple departments. Advocates for hiring when necessary, but also thinks creatively to solve immediate staffing needs

* In tandem with HR Manager and/or Managing Director, facilitates hiring, onboarding, and supporting staff, including addressing workload or performance concerns

* Works with the HR Manager and/or Managing Director to review payroll, as needed, and evaluate staffing levels in

The Operations Director oversees day-to-day operations across multiple departments, manages resources and people, and helps implement workflows to ensure Ambient Inks is running smoothly and in line with our strategic goals. This position requires an organized, systems-level thinker and someone confident in both their own leadership and management abilities. An emotional intelligence based approach to supervision, and an eye for developing and implementing complex processes, will serve this position well.

We like to bring on humans that have an interest in music, art, sustainability and are a

**Operations, Workflow & Systems Improvement**

* Oversees day-to-day operations within Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment, ensuring our clients are satisfied and our products are meeting Ambient Inks’ standards

* Helps to establish benchmarks and goals for the various departments, and supports in the achievement of those goals

* Thinks innovatively on how to improve systems, processes, and policies company-wide in an effort to achieve our goals

* Works with Account Managers to address procedural issues and collaborate to solve problems

* Collaborates with leadership on how to improve

The successful candidate will be a strategic leader with a proven track record of building high-performing teams, driving operational excellence, and leading growth initiatives within aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.

* Evaluate and justify investments in equipment, automation, facilities, and technology.

* Ensure operational processes maintain full product traceability, configuration control, and compliance with airworthiness requirements.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Drive continuous improvement in safety, quality, throughput, productivity, utilization, and on-time delivery performance.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 Quality Management Systems, aerospace manufacturing standards, root cause corrective action methodologies, and regulatory compliance requirements.

* Translate enterprise and department-level priorities into clear operational plans, scorecards, and accountability for the operations team.
* Build and evolve the operations team structure to support growth and ensure the right people are in the right seats.
* Serve as the senior operational decisionmaker for production scheduling, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Report to the CEO/Owner on operational performance, risks, op

* Partner with the CEO/Owner on organizational design and succession planning as the operations function scales.

* Demonstrated experience overseeing manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution

This position is for a Chief Engineering Sr. Manager for the JASSM program in the Strike Systems program area. As the JASSM

* Leading the E&T team supporting JASSM production, working with suppliers and factories to sustain production operations and meet program and corporate milestones.

* Providing leadership and oversight for transition to production of new JASSM variants and second source suppliers.
* Developing a productive partnership and trusting relationship with the JPO customer through effective communication and collaboration.

* Partnering with Program Management, Production Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality to communicate engineering assessments and align engineering priorities with program needs.
* Guiding Engineering team, IPT leads and cross-functional teams in program planning, scheduling, trade studies, design concepts, verification, and critical life cycle reviews.
* Ensuring program staffing is appropriate from an E&T perspective.
* Collaborating with Engineering Excellence management to ensure program milestones are successfully completed.
* Supporting and leading program technical reviews and participa

* Ensuring program staffing is appropriate from an E&T perspective.
* Collaborating with Engineering Excellence management to ensure program milestones are successfully completed.
* Supporting and leading program technical reviews and participating in monthly E&T meetings, staff meetings, and other critical program activities.
* Sharing lessons learned and coordinating tasks with the entire Chief Engineer staff

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership for production execution, transition to production, and supporting proposal activities.
* Protect system integrity and reliabil

* Must be available for occasional domestic travel.
* Candidate must have a Secret clearance..
